You see a fridge. The fridge is empty, what a horrible day! You can see an oven. You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The table is massive. On the table you see a knife. You can see a counter. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. You can see a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing is empty. You make a mental note to not get your hopes up the next time you see a stove in a room.

There is an open frosted-glass door leading south. There is an open patio door leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is not blocked by one.

There is a red onion and an orange bell pepper on the floor.
